## Contract impact

- [ ] No canonical semantics change
- [ ] Canonical semantics change (explain below)
- [ ] No persistence/replay compatibility change
- [ ] Compatibility/migration impact documented
- [ ] No new mandatory runtime network dependency
- [ ] One-file/direct-open impact documented

### Authority / determinism / resource notes

Describe authority boundaries, determinism class, resource bounds, and cross-domain dependencies.

## Scientific / provenance impact

State model fidelity, references/data provenance, uncertainty, and forbidden claims where relevant. Write `N/A` when genuinely not applicable.

## Evidence

### Executed

List exact commands, environments, browsers/devices, and results that actually ran.

### Not executed / not verified

List relevant evidence that did not run. Do not turn absence of evidence into `PASS`.

## Source and contribution rights

- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution.
- [ ] Third-party code/data/assets and required notices are identified.
- [ ] I have read `LICENSING.md` and `docs/community/CONTRIBUTOR_RIGHTS.md`.
- [ ] I understand that merge may require the project's contributor-rights process once formally activated.

## AI assistance

Disclose material AI assistance when relevant to review risk, or write `None/materially insignificant`.
